visual.description: Sticky top bar with icon utilities (location, search) on far left, centered wordmark logo with 'PARIS' subtitle, and account icon on far right.
Secondary navigation bar below logo bar with 4 evenly spaced uppercase text links centered horizontally.
Full-viewport-width video background with large centered all-caps headline text overlaid and a single underlined CTA link below it.
Three equal-width product cards on a light cream background, each with a centered product image above two lines of centered uppercase text caption.

Two-column editorial layout with a narrower left column holding a product image and Instagram handle, and a wider right column holding a larger product image; preceded by a full-width centered section heading.
Two-column split where the left half is a light cream background with large left-aligned headline, subtitle, and CTA link, and the right half is a full-bleed product photograph.
Full-width photograph section with large white uppercase headline text overlaid at lower-left, partially visible as it transitions into the next section.
Full-width centered heading above a 3-column equal-width product grid on a light cream background, each card showing a product image above a single uppercase centered caption.
Two-column section with left column containing centered heading, body copy, and an email input form, and right column showing an illustrated image.
Full-width dark green section with a horizontally scrollable carousel of boutique photographs, left/right chevron arrows, and boutique name/address text centered below the active slide.
Medium green footer with 4 equal-width columns of stacked centered text links under uppercase category headings, with the rightmost column containing accessibility toggles.

Full-width footer bottom section with centered monogram icon, wordmark, tagline text, social media icons in a horizontal row, and a language/locale selector at bottom left with copyright at bottom right.
